name: Path Tracing Estimators for Refractive Radiative Transfer
definition: Path tracing estimators for refractive radiative transfer work by generating subpaths via alternating non-linear ray tracing and scattering events, then forming complete paths via direct connections between vertices.
summary: Path Tracing Estimators for Refractive Radiative Transfer are unbiased light transport methods for heterogeneous media that use curved paths satisfying Hamilton's equations instead of straight lines.
